Change denial_rate_by_segment denominator from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims' so rates reflect denials among adjudicated claims only.

reusable_lessons.lesson: For denial rate analysis, use adjudicated claims (Paid, Denied, Adjusted) as the denominator, not all claims. This excludes claims not yet adjudicated and provides the correct statistical basis for comparing denial rates across segments.
